experiment: P-BSAM-Review-12: Plain MSE versus original BSAM, paired fixed 14 epochs
run_order: seed43/plain, seed43/bsam, seed44/plain, seed44/bsam, seed45/plain, seed45/bsam
initialization: same deterministic random initialization for both arms within each seed; no Review-02 weight continuation
input: same official Train/Validation sample identities and frozen MSE-FiLM preprocessing for both arms
scheduler: StepLR(step_size=30, gamma=0.1), stepped once after each completed epoch
precision: BF16 autocast forward, FP32 losses and optimizer
plain: unweighted center-pixel MSE, one forward/backward per update
bsam: original two-pass BSAM from frozen source: Train-only inverse-sqrt 10 Mg/ha bin weights in ascent pass, rho=0.2, unweighted center-pixel MSE at perturbed weights in second pass, restore weights then one Adam update; BN running stats update only in first pass
validation: all 103550 official Validation rows after every epoch; eval mode and no gradients
checkpoint_selection: strictly lowest full Validation Overall RMSE among epochs 1-14; Q50-Q90 and Q90+ are secondary only
test: not accessed for training, tuning or checkpoint selection; any eventual single final Test evaluation requires a separate instruction after all six checkpoints are frozen
primary_question: At equal epochs, updates, and sample exposure, does BSAM improve accuracy enough to justify its extra compute?
multi_seed_summary: paired seed differences; mean and sample SD; descriptive paired 95% CI with n=3 and explicit uncertainty limit
